QuestInfo.name: [Chu Chu] Fresh from the Slurpy Forest 2
QuestInfo.0: Pibik, the oldest of the Pi siblings, is helping you and Simia pick out ingredients. He has a bit of a temper, but he really knows his meat. Follow his instructions and assemble the meat patty!
QuestInfo.1:
Pibik, the oldest of the Pi siblings, is helping you and Simia pick out ingredients. He has a bit of a temper, but he really knows his meat.

Pibik tells you to get Soft Sole from Unripe Wolfruit and Chewy Sole from Ripe Wolfruit.
QuestInfo.2: You finally got all the ingredients with help from Pibik, the oldest of the Pi siblings, to make the meat patty. It doesn't look like a very balanced sandwich, but as long as Muto likes it...
